A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the AcrB–AcrA–TolC complex is stabilized by both AcrB DN and DC subdomain β‐hairs and AcrA, and that the AcrAB pump is a dynamic complex in which the AcrB hairpins play a critical role in complex assembly and TolC opening.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the DN β‐hairpins of AcrB are critical for the formation of a stable complex with TolC, which is required for drug efflux.
the AcrB‐TolC interaction is more complex than a simple lock‐and‐key mechanism.
AcrA and AcrB are both essential for the stability of the AcrAB– TolC complex and the opening of TolC for the efflux of drug molecules.
